name: Sentinel High Command
jurisdiction: Operational command of the Sentinel program: division commanders per suit class, tactical unit leaders (5-10 squads), autonomous strike teams; mission-critical override authority when bureaucratic delay risks mission failure.

relationships.org_union_marshals: Coordinate offices, distinct chains: Grand Marshal (SHC) holds operational command of Sentinels; Chief Marshal heads the Union Marshals service (owner ruling CL-13a, 2026-07-20)

promotion_note: Created 2026-07-20 at STAGING per owner ruling CL-13a: SHC is a distinct office from the Chief Marshal. This ruling renders the GUMAS_Factions.json anomaly coherent ('Sentinels' listed as GU substructure parallel to Union Marshals).

leadership_incumbent.name: Grand Marshal Aric Thal
leadership_incumbent.source: Silent Dagger mission lead, Sentinel-Praetor (LEDGER-MISSIONS-0001); deterministic selection rule Charter Art. V

command_structure.reporting: Advises the Union Chancellor and Military High Command directly.
command_structure.significance: Consistent with char_aric_thal, recorded as Grand Marshal of Sentinel High Command, and with that record's existing note describing an SHC direct advisory uplink to the Chancellor and Military High Command.
command_structure.referent_caution: The source names 'Military High Command'. Canon holds org_union_military_command — 'Union Military Command', aliases ['UMC'] — and no source binds the two names to one body. They are NOT identified here. An earlier draft of this block asserted that identification on the strength of the shared words 'Military' and 'Command'; that is the same reasoning rejected for 'Valkyrie Sentinels' on char_eira_valkyrie, and it is withdrawn. 'Military High Command' currently has no entity record and stands as an unbound referent.
command_structure.correction: Corrected 2026-09-01 by an audit of the reconciliation commit that wrote it.
